GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (5 Apr 47) CCS
(SCAPIN - 1603/10)
APO 500
8 September 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Reactivation of the Coastal Radio Service of the Japanese Ministry of Telecommunications to Handle Ship-Shore Traffic for Allied Merchant Shipping.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for Japanese Government, file AG 676.3 (5 Apr 47)CCS, SCAPIN 1603/9, dated 25 August 1949, subject as above.
2. Paragraph 5 of Inclosure 1 of reference memorandum is amended to read as follows:
"The accounting of message tolls will be the responsibility of the Swedish Telegraph Board (Telegrafstyrelsen) and the Japanese Ministry of Telecommunications. Monthly statement of accounts will be submitted by both agencies through General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, by calendar months beginning 1 September 1949."
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R. M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
